story.text: 승객 여러분, 이번엔 푸른 빛깔의 예술, 강진 상공이에요. 고려 도공들의 숨결을 느껴보세요.
story.reading: seung-gaek yeo-reo-bun, i-beon-en pu-reun bit-kkal-ui ye-sul, gang-jin sang-gong-i-e-yo. go-ryeo do-gong-deul-ui sum-gyeol-eul neu-kkyeo-bo-se-yo.
story.en: Passengers, this time it's the art of blue, above Gangjin. Feel the breath of the Goryeo potters.

story.text: 강진 하면 떠오르는 것, 바로 '청자'예요. 옥처럼 은은한 푸른빛이 감도는 고려시대의 아름다운 도자기랍니다.
story.reading: gang-jin ha-myeon tteo-o-reu-neun geot, ba-ro cheong-ja-ye-yo. ok-cheo-reom eun-eun-han pu-reun-bich-i gam-do-neun go-ryeo-si-dae-ui a-reum-da-un do-ja-gi-ram-ni-da.
story.en: What comes to mind with Gangjin is 'celadon'. It's a beautiful Goryeo-era pottery with a soft blue-green glow like jade.

story.text: 청자도 결국은 '도자기'의 한 종류예요. 고운 흙을 빚고 구워 만드는 그릇을 도자기라고 부르지요.
story.reading: cheong-ja-do gyeol-gug-eun do-ja-gi-ui han jong-nyu-ye-yo. go-un heulg-eul bij-go gu-wo man-deu-neun geu-reus-eul do-ja-gi-ra-go bu-reu-ji-yo.
story.en: Celadon, too, is a type of 'pottery'. A bowl shaped and fired from fine clay is called pottery.

story.text: 도자기를 빚을 때는 '물레'를 돌려요. 빙글빙글 도는 물레 위에서 흙덩이가 둥근 그릇 모양으로 변한답니다.
story.reading: do-ja-gi-reul bij-eul ttae-neun mul-le-reul dol-lyeo-yo. bing-geul-bing-geul do-neun mul-le wi-e-seo heuk-deong-i-ga dung-geun geu-reut mo-yang-eu-ro byeon-han-dam-ni-da.
story.en: When shaping pottery, you spin the 'potter's wheel'. On the spinning wheel, a lump of clay turns into a round bowl shape.

story.text: 모양을 다 빚으면 '가마'에 넣어 구워요. 아주 뜨거운 불 속에서 하루 넘게 구워야 단단한 청자가 완성돼요.
story.reading: mo-yang-eul da bij-eu-myeon ga-ma-e neoh-eo gu-wo-yo. a-ju tteu-geo-un bul sog-e-seo ha-ru neom-ge gu-wo-ya dan-dan-han cheong-ja-ga wan-seong-dwae-yo.
story.en: Once fully shaped, it's put into a 'kiln' and fired. It must be fired in intense heat for over a day for a sturdy celadon to be completed.

story.text: 이 모든 과정을 이끄는 사람이 '장인'이에요. 오랜 세월 갈고닦은 손끝으로 영롱한 비색을 만들어낸답니다.
story.reading: i mo-deun gwa-jeong-eul i-kkeu-neun sa-ram-i jang-in-i-e-yo. o-raen se-wol gal-go-dak-eun son-kkeut-eu-ro yeong-rong-han bi-saeg-eul man-deul-eo-nae-ndam-ni-da.
story.en: The person who leads this whole process is the 'craftsman'. With fingertips honed over long years, they create the glittering jade-blue color.

story.text: 자, 푸른빛 다섯 단어를 마음에 새기셨나요? 이제 정성 가득 문제를 풀어볼까요!
story.reading: ja, pu-reun-bit da-seot dan-eo-reul ma-eum-e sae-gi-syeot-na-yo? i-je jeong-seong ga-deuk mun-je-reul pul-eo-bol-kka-yo!
story.en: Now, have you engraved the five blue words in your heart? Let's solve some questions with full care!

words.example_en: Celadon is pottery with a blue-green glow.
Pottery is shaped and made from clay.
The craftsman makes bowls with great care.
It's fired at a high heat in the kiln.
You shape the clay while spinning the potter's wheel.

sentences.en: Celadon greatly developed during the Goryeo period.

sentences.ko: 도자기는 천 도가 넘는 불에 구워요.
sentences.reading: do-ja-gi-neun cheon do-ga neom-neun bul-e gu-wo-yo
sentences.en: Pottery is fired at over a thousand degrees.
A bowl is born from the craftsman's fingertips.
The temperature inside the kiln is very important.

sentences.ko: 물레 위에서 흙이 그릇 모양이 돼요.
sentences.reading: mul-le wi-e-seo heulg-i geu-reut mo-yang-i dwae-yo
sentences.en: On the wheel, clay becomes the shape of a bowl.
